detailZones.title: Wall hatch and interior window
detailZones.description: The square metal hatch is on the left. The wide interior window shows shelves and containers in the adjoining room.

detailZones.title: Pipettes and benchtop instruments
detailZones.description: Four pipettes stand in a blue rack on the rear counter. Nearby instruments have a clear cover, displays and front controls. The metal drawers are below the counter.

detailZones.title: Microscopes and sample trays
detailZones.description: The whole-instrument label identifies the central microscope. The separate workstation entrance is on the large microscope at the far left. Small jars and labeled cases sit in trays across the foreground.

detailZones.title: Glass-fronted storage
detailZones.description: A tall glass-fronted cabinet holds rows of containers. Its metal door hardware and shelves remain visible behind the bench.

detailZones.title: Staining tray and glassware
detailZones.description: Individual rectangular baths sit inside a handled tray. Two glass beakers and stacks of colored boxes stand beside it.

detailZones.title: Microtome
detailZones.description: The machine at the front right has a dark clamp, an angled holder, a long lever, and a broad cream-colored base.

detailZones.title: Computer desk and window
detailZones.description: A monitor and keyboard sit beside the outside window. The chair, sill, and desk frame are visible behind the sectioning machine.
